description:
Measure a 3D asset file without placing it: bounds, origin, meshes, largest flat faces, open pipe ends, Marker3D anchors and collision shapes. Measure each kit piece once before placing it. Next: summer_instantiate_scene.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/inspect-asset"}

detail.description: summary (default): open_loops lists only port-like loops (radius over 2 cm with a partner loop facing another way, or the one opening of an end piece on its bounding-box face), or none. full: every…

maxCharacters.description: Most characters of text to return (default 4000). A longer result is cut and says so.

maxTriangles.description: Triangle budget (100-300000) for the face and open-loop analysis (AABBs and counts are always complete). summary.warnings says when the budget cut the analysis and which budget covers the whole mesh.

path.description: Asset to measure, e.g. 'res://kit/facade/wall_single_01.tscn'. It is loaded and instanced off-scene, never added to an open scene.

name: summer_inspect_asset
title: Measure a 3D asset file
